column1: # Google News <source url="…">Display Name</source> pairs, harvested 2026-08-28.
# WHAT: every distinct (source url, display name) pair Google News RSS emitted
# across 70 queries, each query one REAL storyline label taken off the dev
# archive — the deepening plane's actual work list, not invented searches. The
# third column is how many of the 6,008 items carried that pair.
# WHY IT IS HERE: `stripOutletSuffix` in @zammy/news-client decides whether a
# trailing " - Outlet" segment names the outlet, and until G5 it required the
# display name to BE the domain stem. 26.2% of these items failed that test.
# The four rules that replaced it were chosen on a held-out half of these
# queries and are scored against this file, so anyone can re-run the comparison
# instead of taking the comment's word for it — including the display-name MAP
# the plan proposed, which this corpus is what rejected.
# NOT A TEST FIXTURE FOR PARSING: `fixtures/google-news-search-*.xml` are the
# wire-shape fixtures. This is a measurement corpus.
